hook: When your divot travels farther than the ball.
beats: Mulligan: I take a proper divot.
setting: On the fairway, open short grass behind, both babies looking down at a ball and a torn chunk of turf.
action: Mulligan swings, a big clump of turf flies while the ball stays put, and he proudly holds up the divot as Birdie stares.
sound: birdsong, a club thud, a chunk of turf flipping
judge: 'Divot's beautiful though' is a strong, deadpan last-line laugh.
